text: Department of Tourism and Hotel Management Being adapted to the development of modern tourism and hotel management industry, the department of tourism and hotel management has raised many intermediate or senior managerial and technical talented persons with lofty makings, consummation personality, solid foundation of basic skills and exquisite skill. The graduates widely get employed in star-rated hotels, travel agencies, scenic spot units, modern commerce companies and so on. The department positively establishes the professional environment and reduces the disparity between talented persons’ practice are in construction. The department implements the department thought diligently which is to unify “produce, study and grind “.Till now, the institution has established friendly relationship with many domestic and foreign institutions. “Surmount your expectation!” we diligently strive after for it.
